MANDATORY QUALITY AUDIT VERIFICATION — 100% CANONICAL 2-LAYER MONOCHROME ARCHITECTURE
The approved dark reference was not modified; its geometry, typography, and element positions are the single source of truth.
RADMAN (Didot serif) and SILVER 925 are 100% visible, prominent, and sharp across all four full-logo colorways.
The R is crisp and visible inside the Shamsa in both ivory (#FAF7F2) and matte black (#0B0B0E) colorways.
✓ 4. SHAMSA INTERIOR MATCHES FULL CANVAS BACKGROUND:
The interior of the Shamsa matches the full canvas background (#FAF7F2 on ivory, #0B0B0E on dark, transparent on transparent).
✓ 5. ZERO LOCAL BACKGROUND PATCHES OR RECTANGLES:
No local background patches exist. The unwanted gray/black rectangle behind the bottom text is 100% removed.
The light version is a true mathematical color inversion of the dark version. ViewBox 0 0 1200 900 guarantees zero cropped edges.
All versions share one single canonical foreground artwork group. Only global background color and foreground color change.
Transparent files are truly transparent; all hollow spaces inside Shamsa and negative spaces reveal the checkerboard cleanly.
